question: When was the company that built the first steam locomotive to carry passengers on a public rail line founded?

completions.text:
Below is some historical context before the answer:

• In 1825 the Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in England and used a steam locomotive called “Locomotion No. 1” to carry passengers. This locomotive was built by George Stephenson, who is often called the “Father of Railways.”  
• Although George Stephenson built that pioneering locomotive, he worked largely as an independent engineer rather than under a formal company name.  
• Later, his son Robert Stephenson went on to found a very well‐known locomotive-building firm—Robert Stephenson and Company—which became famous for building the “Rocket” locomotive (built in 1829 and later used on the Liverpool and Manchester Railway).

Because the question asks, “When was the company that built the first steam locomotive to carry passengers on a public rail line founded?” many sources associate that honor with Robert Stephenson and Company. That company was founded in 1823.

So, the answer is: 1823.
